name: Bluebarry Product Recommendation Quizzes for WooCommerce
author: bluebarry

sections.description:
The official Product Quiz Solution every WooCommerce store needs to build beautiful Quiz Funnels. Instead of overwhelming customers with choices, you guide them through a simple question flow that identifies their specific needs and matches them to products they’ll actually buy.

HOW TO GET STARTED

Start building a free quiz funnel

This plugin helps you to implement the quiz funnels that you’ve created with bluebarry on your WooCommerce store.

Quick note upfront: This plugin is used to make it easy to launch your bluebarry quiz funnels inside of your WooCommerce store. To actually build and design the product quizzes, you’ll need a bluebarry account.

If you don’t have a bluebarry account yet you can request a trial and start building your first quiz funnel for free.

These are the steps you can follow:

1) You build your Quiz design and questions & answers in bluebarry.

Create your quiz flow, design the look and feel, and set up questions that help identify what your customers actually need. The bluebarry platform gives you full control over colors, fonts, and layout to match your brand

2) You connect your WooCommerce catalog

Connect your WooCommerce store to bluebarry with your Tenant ID and API key. Version 2.0.0 adds direct product sync from the plugin settings, including products, variations, prices, stock status, categories, tags, SKUs, and product attributes. Products can sync automatically when they are created, updated, deleted, or trashed.

3) You launch your recommendation quiz on your WooCommerce store

Using our WooCommerce plugin (Yes, this one), you can embed your quiz anywhere on your store. Choose from popups, slide-ins, embedded sections, or trigger the quiz based on user behavior like time on page or scroll depth.

This plugin helps you to easily implement bluebarry on your WooCommerce store with three key functions:

  • Quiz Funnel Launching: Make sure your recommendation quizzes launch exactly where you want them to launch.
  • Product Sync: Sync your WooCommerce catalog directly to bluebarry, including variants and product attributes.
  • Performance tracking: If your customers use your quiz to actually buy a product, that’s valuable data you want to send towards your bluebarry dashboard. The plugin automatically tracks when quiz recommendations lead to actual purchases, giving you clear ROI data on your bluebarry quiz performance.

WHY BUILD WOOCOMMERCE PRODUCT RECOMMENDATION QUIZZES?

When you surpass 50 products on your WooCommerce store it becomes unreasonable to expect your visitors to just know what to get.

And we know this to be true:

77% of online shoppers say they’re overwhelmed and abandon their shopping journey because of it.

Choice overload and decision stress are real problems for real people (which you sometimes forget when you’re in digital marketing looking at web metrics all day).

Think about your own shopping experience. When you land on a store with hundreds of products and no clear guidance, what do you do? Most people leave and buy from a competitor with a clearer path to purchase.

What does this mean for your WooCommerce store?

  • Less people buy (lower conversions): Confused visitors bounce instead of converting
  • More people buy the wrong product (higher returns): When customers guess, they often get products that don’t fit their needs
  • Higher customer service costs: More questions, complaints, and support tickets from uncertain buyers
  • Lower average order value: Customers stick to safe, basic options instead of premium products that better fit their needs

But like any problem, this one is solvable.

Give your visitors product recommendations that they’ll actually buy with bluebarry.

Bluebarry helps you build high-converting Quiz Funnels that result in perfect product recommendations. Instead of overwhelming customers with choices, you guide them through a simple question flow that identifies their specific needs and matches them to the right products.

WHY BLUEBARRY

We developed bluebarry specifically for DTC eCommerce brands that value design and have a large product catalog (50 to 100,000 SKUs). Here’s what makes us different:

  • Design mobile-first quiz funnels Come on… it’s 2025. Your product quiz builder should have a mobile first approach. That’s 80% of your traffic. We’re also a big fan of making things look beautiful if you can. Your design options are very flexible – custom colors, fonts, button styles, and layout options that match your brand perfectly. No generic-looking quizzes that scream “third-party tool.”

  • Launch in any way you like Popup? Slide in? Embedded on a landing page? Launch after 10 seconds on the page? Launch after a button click? Launch when someone tries to exit? It’s all possible and easy to configure within the settings of your quiz funnel. You can even A/B test different launch methods to see what works best for your audience.

  • Connect your product feed (catalog) If you have anywhere between 50 and 100,000 SKUs, matching your product feeds to quiz answers is a complex task. Manual mapping takes forever and breaks when you add new products. Bluebarry automatically syncs with your WooCommerce catalog and uses smart matching based on product attributes, categories, tags, and custom fields. Add new products and they automatically get included in recommendations.

  • Recommend products that your customers want to buy Our recommendation engine doesn’t just randomly suggest products. It analyzes customer responses, product attributes, inventory levels, and your business rules to suggest products that actually make sense. You can set rules like “never recommend out-of-stock items” or “prioritize higher-margin products” or “always include accessories with main products.”

  • Post-quiz follow-up Want to send your quiz-takers automated emails? Just connect with your ESP (like Klaviyo or Mailchimp) and send the product recommendations by email to your quiz takers. This is huge for conversions – people don’t always buy immediately, but they’ll often return when they get a well-timed email with their personalized recommendations. (Spoiler: this results in 25-40% more conversions from quiz traffic.)

  • Performance and conversion tracking Performance tracking is built in and detailed. See which quiz questions are most effective, which recommendations get clicked most, and most importantly – which quiz results drive actual sales. Track revenue attribution, conversion rates by recommendation type, and customer lifetime value from quiz users vs. regular traffic. This data helps you optimize your quiz for maximum ROI.

ABOUT BLUEBARRY

Bluebarry is a product quiz builder for DTC eCommerce brands with 50+ products.

Why ‘brands’? Because we build our software for eCommerce businesses that are building brands, not just selling products. In other words, we take the design of your quiz extremely seriously.

Why ’50+ products’? Because those companies are the ones that need product quizzes and finders the most. But did you ever try an existing solution? Probably not, because if you have a larger product catalog, most tools create such a horrible experience that you were probably done with the whole “product quiz thing” and never looked back again.

We built bluebarry to fix exactly this problem – beautiful, scalable product recommendation quizzes that actually work with large catalogs.

If you want to learn more about bluebarry, or specifically about WooCommerce recommendation quizzes, visit our website for case studies, quiz examples, other integrations, and detailed guides.

If you have specific questions about installing our WooCommerce plugin or need help with setup, contact us:

sections.installation:
Automated Installation

Getting your product quizzes live on your WooCommerce store is easier than you think:

  1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “bluebarry” in the plugin directory
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Look for the new Bluebarry menu in your admin sidebar
  5. Connect your bluebarry account using your Tenant ID and API key from Bluebarry Studio
  6. Click Sync All Products Now to send your WooCommerce catalog to Bluebarry

Manual Installation

For the hands-on approach (or if automatic installation doesn’t work):

  1. Download the plugin file from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Follow the same setup steps as above

Need more help with plugin installation? Check out the official WordPress plugin installation guide.

First time setting up? The plugin includes step-by-step setup documentation, and our support team helps trial users get everything configured correctly. Most stores are up and running with their first quiz in under 30 minutes.
sections.faq:
Is this a free plugin?

Yes, the bluebarry WooCommerce plugin is free. However, this plugin is only meant to implement the quiz funnels on your WooCommerce store. To actually build the quiz funnels you’ll need a bluebarry account. Look at our pricing to learn more about the different plans we offer.

How do I sync my products?

Open the Bluebarry settings page in WordPress, enter your Tenant ID and API key from Bluebarry Studio, save the settings, and click Sync All Products Now. When auto-sync is enabled, product changes are also sent to Bluebarry when WooCommerce products or variations are created, updated, deleted, or trashed.

Does product sync include variations and attributes?

Yes. Version 2.0.0 syncs purchasable products and variations, groups variations with their parent product ID, and includes product attributes, categories, tags, price, compare-at price, currency, stock status, stock quantity, SKU, image URL, and product URL.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is required for product sync, add-to-cart, and conversion tracking. If WooCommerce is inactive, the plugin shows an admin warning and keeps the basic advisor script behavior available.

How do I build a high-converting product quiz?

We get it. You’re not going to use a recommendation quiz funnel for fun. It needs to get you some results. In other words: conversions. Take a look at some of our guides, that cover exactly this: How to build a product quiz that converts (guide)

Is this a form of Guided Selling?

Guided selling is a commonly used term in the eCom marketing world. Tools like product quizzes are all part of “guided selling” tactics that eCommerce businesses use to direct customers toward products that match their specific needs and budget.
sections.changelog:
2.0.3

  • Send conversion tracking events to Bluebarry as non-blocking (fire-and-forget) requests so checkout completion is never slowed down or blocked by the Bluebarry API
  • Identify quiz session users by their billing email on checkout so post-purchase automations (Klaviyo, Omnisend) can match orders to the correct profile

2.0.2

  • Refresh WooCommerce cart fragments after add-to-cart so theme cart icons update without a page reload

2.0.1

  • Fix WooCommerce product sync so product-level attributes are always sent as collection properties, even when a product has only one selected attribute value
  • Keep shared Bluebarry property types consistent when different products use one or multiple values for the same attribute

2.0.0

  • Add direct WooCommerce product sync to Bluebarry using API keys
  • Add manual bulk product sync from the Bluebarry settings page
  • Add automatic product and variation sync on create, update, delete, and trash events
  • Sync product variations, attributes, categories, tags, prices, stock status, stock quantity, SKU, image URL, and product URL
  • Add WooCommerce add-to-cart handling from quiz recommendations
  • Add plugin heartbeat and deactivation tracking for active installations
  • Harden product sync when WooCommerce is inactive
  • Replace PHP 8-only string helpers for PHP 7.4 compatibility

1.3.2

  • Support WooCommerce block checkout for conversion tracking

1.3.1

  • Fix conversion tracking when user logs in during checkout

1.3.0

  • Export custom product attributes as individual columns instead of a single custom_attributes dump
  • Resolve variant-specific attribute values instead of showing all parent values
  • Skip parent variable and grouped products from export (only export actual purchasable items)

1.2.0

  • Add product variation support with group_id column for grouping variants

1.1.2

  • Fix bug in attribution for conversion tracking

1.1.1

  • Round prices to decimals configured in Woocommerce

1.1.0

  • Add basic product export functionality

1.0.3

  • Added link to pricing page.

1.0.2

  • Added changelog.

1.0.1

  • Initial release.
